decision.reason: Focused phone/GPS S3 interaction is still far from the Public-0.55/review threshold. Treat it as design evidence only, not as a candidate route.

interaction.bounded_pair_rule: Pair phone-rest features with low-mobility GPS features and phone/wearable-active or discordance features with context/mobility GPS features.

purpose: Test the cross-source S3 phone/wearable plus GPS micro-alignment as focused interactions.
